title: Fleet envelope (host channel, protocol v1)
description: Every WebSocket message on /api/fleet/host is one UTF-8 JSON text frame (max 1 MiB) of this shape: the same envelope as the server channel (FLEET.md §5, §18). The payload is validated separately, against messages/<type>.json.

ack.description: highest contiguous peer seq durably processed

ts.description: sender clock, ms since Unix epoch

ref.description: id of the message this answers (host.result: the command id)
